location_name: Taiping Island (Itu Aba), Tizard Bank, Spratly (Nansha) Islands
summary: In September 1980 eight civilian researchers of the Taiwan Provincial Fisheries Research Institute went to Taiping Island to conduct research, and on 25 September they officially registered their domiciles (household registration) on the island, the first civilian residents recorded there; the Institute's ship surveyed the waters around Tizard Bank as a fishing ground.
